content.short: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization for Spanish speakers to collaborate and solve local problems.
content.description: ALDEA has the mission to enable change in Latin America by creating an ecosystem that will allow people to come together to communicate, self-govern, produce and trade as a Decentralized and Autonomous Community. We believe that a new world is possible, powered by blockchain technology and the use of smart contracts, not only to avoid the intervention of third parties or any central entity that may exercise censorship within the interactions of our community but also to give power to the people and to promote transparency and efficiency in all the region.
